name: project-memory
description: Distills the conversation in the background into project memory (the built-in memory) and a progress file; a rule confirmed in several sessions is proposed to you before it goes into CLAUDE.md, and a procedure becomes a project skill

distill.title: Automatic distill
distill.description: Every so many messages, after idling for a while, or at /clear, Sonnet distills the new conversation into memories, rules and procedures and updates the progress file. Off by default; turn it on for a while with /project-memory on; /project-memory run still distills by hand when it is off.

distill_every.title: Distill every N messages
distill_every.description: Distill when this many user messages have come since the last distill.

min_context_k.title: Skip automatic distill below this many k of context
min_context_k.description: A conversation that is too short is not distilled every N messages (idling, /clear and manual distills are not limited).

idle_minutes.title: Distill after idling this many minutes
idle_minutes.description: Distill once after this long since the last answer, with 5 or more new messages (context size does not matter). 0 means no distill when idle.

promote.title: Ask Claude to put it in the repo
promote.description: For rules and procedures confirmed in 3 sessions, tell Claude in the first message of each session: a rule is proposed to you before it goes into CLAUDE.md, a procedure becomes a project skill (neither is committed).
